---
title: "Combined South Sudan + Bangladesh analysis"
output: html_document
---

Reproduces **Table S6** and **Figure S5**, plus the NPV quoted in the Discussion
(acute jaundice plus abdominal pain or fatigue/malaise: 77%, 95% CI 74 to 80).

Only symptoms collected in both populations are used. Post-stratification weights
give each population 50% of the total weight. Weights sum to the total number of patients (2,046), so weighted 2x2 counts are in
patient units. 95% CIs are percentile
bootstrap intervals; resampling is done within each population so the weights stay
fixed.

```{r setup, message = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(here)
library(ggplot2)
source(here("R", "data.R"))
source(here("R", "metrics.R"))
source(here("R", "combos.R"))

joint <- load_joint()
count(joint, dataset, infect_bin)
```

```{r search}
threshold <- 0.5
joint_results <- lapply(c(at_least_1 = 1, at_least_2 = 2), function(k) {
  evaluate_case_defs(joint, JOINT_SYMPTOMS, min_k = k, weights = joint$weight)
})
```

## Table S6: top definitions by specificity

```{r tableS6}
set.seed(123)
top <- lapply(names(joint_results), function(nm) {
  k <- c(at_least_1 = 1, at_least_2 = 2)[[nm]]
  best <- select_case_defs(joint_results[[nm]], threshold, n = 10)
  ci <- bootstrap_case_defs(joint, JOINT_SYMPTOMS, k, best$id)
  cbind(rule = nm, format_selected(left_join(best, ci, by = "id")))
})
top <- do.call(rbind, top)
top
```

## Discussion: abdominal pain or fatigue/malaise

```{r npv_example}
example <- joint_results$at_least_1 %>% filter(case_def == "abdomen_ever + drowsy_ever")
set.seed(123)
example_ci <- bootstrap_case_defs(joint, JOINT_SYMPTOMS, 1, example$id)
format_selected(left_join(example, example_ci, by = "id"))
```

## Figure S5

The published figure shades specificity < 0.6 as "< WHO, IMC". In this combined dataset
the international definitions have specificity of 36% (MSF), 26% (WHO) and 11% (IMC),
so every plotted definition is more specific than all three. The shading is omitted
here; the reference values are printed instead.

```{r figS5, fig.width = 7, fig.height = 5}
international_spec <- sapply(INTERNATIONAL_DEFS$bd, function(s) {
  meets <- rowSums(joint[s]) >= 1
  sum(joint$weight * (!meets & joint$infect_bin == 0)) / sum(joint$weight * (joint$infect_bin == 0))
})
round(international_spec, 2)

abbrev <- c(abdomen_ever = "A", drowsy_ever = "F", head_ever = "H", mental_ever = "M",
            nausea_ever = "N", vomit_ever = "V", appetite_ever = "L", fever_ever = "Fe",
            diarrhea_ever = "D")
top1 <- select_case_defs(joint_results$at_least_1, threshold, n = 10) %>%
  mutate(label = vapply(strsplit(case_def, " + ", fixed = TRUE),
                        function(s) paste(sort(abbrev[s]), collapse = "|"), ""))
ggplot(top1, aes(specificity, sensitivity, label = label)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_text(hjust = -0.25, size = 3.5) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0.5, 0.7), ylim = c(0.5, 0.6)) +
  labs(x = "Specificity", y = "Sensitivity",
       caption = "A abdominal pain, F fatigue/malaise, H headache, M mental status, N nausea, V vomiting") +
  theme_minimal()
```
